$comment: 每月依賴檢查用：已經看過、但這次不升的決定。deferredLatest 記下當時審視的版本，PyPI 一超過它就自動恢復提醒。

pytest.reason: maintainer test suite baseline; keeps minimum compatibility floor across python 3.10-3.14

pytest-asyncio.reason: Retain the >=0.23 floor across Python 3.10-3.14; tested on 1.5.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

httpx.reason: Retain the >=0.24 test-client floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21) and no fork need for a newer API. Tested on 0.28.1 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

ruff.reason: Retain the >=0.9 linter floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-22) and no gate needs a newer rule. 0.17.5 and 0.17.6 release notes read: no stable rule added to E9/F; the two pyflakes changes (F823 false-negative fix, F841 ignoring __traceback_hide__) change nothing here. Tested on 0.17.6 (clean Python 3.14 venv, 2026-11-22): dev_check green, and ruff E9,F over the whole tree gives the same 15858 diagnostics as 0.17.4.

pydantic.reason: Retain upstream >=2.0 compatibility floor; defer raising the baseline until validation/schema behavior is checked across the Python 3.10-3.14 matrix.

jsonschema.reason: Retain upstream >=4.20 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21) and upstream has not moved it. Tested on 4.26.0 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

python-dotenv.reason: Retain upstream >=1.0 floor: CVE-2026-28684 (fixed in 1.2.2) is in set_key, and this repo only calls dotenv_values (lib/env_loader.py); raise the floor to >=1.2.2 if set_key or any .env writer is ever used. Tested on 1.2.4 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

Pillow.reason: upstream runtime compatibility floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline

numpy.reason: Retain upstream >=1.24 floor; 2.5.5 needs Python >=3.12, so 3.10/3.11 resolve an older release inside the range. Tested on 2.5.5 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version).

requests.reason: Floor raised to >=2.33.0 on 2026-11-21 (clears CVE-2024-35195, CVE-2024-47081, CVE-2026-25645); not raised further because 2.33.0 is the lowest release without a known advisory and the floor is a compatibility promise. Tested on 2.34.2 (clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version) and the requests-importing test files on 2.33.0.

google-auth.reason: Retain upstream >=2.0 floor; service-account Google TTS and Vertex AI authentication has no credential-backed smoke in this review.

google-genai.reason: Retain upstream >=1.0.0 floor; the offline Google provider tests (129 passed) run on 3.0.0, but Lyria, Veo and Gemini Omni live calls still need separately authorized validation, and upstream has not changed the floor.

openai.reason: Retain upstream >=2.44.0 Videos API floor; the offline provider tests (129 passed) run on 3.48.0, but live TTS, image and Sora calls are not validated and upstream has not changed the floor.

fastapi.reason: Retain upstream >=0.110 runtime floor; tracking calesthio/OpenMontage baseline, which is unchanged; the maintenance gates pass on 0.162.2.

uvicorn.reason: Retain upstream >=0.29 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21). No test imports uvicorn; on 0.54.0 a manual smoke served backlot (/api/health, /api/projects, /) on 2026-11-21, alongside clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version.

watchfiles.reason: Retain upstream >=0.21 floor: no known advisory on the floor (OSV, 2026-11-21). No test imports watchfiles; on 1.3.0 a manual awatch smoke saw a file change on Windows on 2026-11-21, alongside clean Python 3.14 venv on 2026-11-21: dev_check and test_product green, fork regressions 812 passed with one local timing-budget flake; CI run 44870503353 green on Python 3.10-3.14 with this version.

torch.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; latest PyPI versions alone do not establish a compatible torch/torchaudio/torchvision and Windows CUDA combination; GPU model inference is not validated in this review.

torchaudio.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; audio extension and torch compatibility must be checked as a matched Windows/CUDA set with real inference, not independent latest versions.

torchvision.reason: Retain upstream GPU floor; defer adoption until matched torch/Windows CUDA and basicsr face_restore/upscale compatibility are validated; upstream PR #875 remains a documented re-review trigger.

websockets.reason: Retain upstream >=14.0 floor; defer baseline adoption until Eleven v4 Turbo and realtime transport behavior is checked on 17.4, beyond the prior 17.3 evidence.

certifi.reason: Retain the upstream security floor 2026.10.19 (eMudhra intermediate CA replacement); the floor is a compatibility promise, and the 2026.10.23 release notes were not reviewed, so the floor is not raised in this pass.

pythainlp.reason: Retain upstream >=5.0 floor (new with the Thai caption work); the Thai caption tests pass on 5.4.0, which is the version installed for review.
